newsitem.title: USA: Nitinol gets FDA nod for more implant test sites.
newsitem.headline: Nitinol gets FDA nod for more implant test sites.

text.p: Nitinol Medical Technologies Inc said Wednesday it has received US Food and Drug Administration approval to add three more sites for clinical trials of its CardioSEAL Septal Occluder.
The three new sites at hospitals in Salt Lake City, Albuquerque and Denver bring the number of investigational sites to 10.
The CardioSEAL Septal Occluder is a cardiac implant designed to close holes in the heart using a minimally invasive catheter-based delivery system.

The company said the implant is also currently being used under clinical investigational protocol at five European and one Canadian center. Nitinol said it is planning a European launch of the product later this year pending successful completion of the clinical trials.
